one_line: Global AI developments span workforce restructuring, infrastructure expansion, and regulatory challenges across multiple jurisdictions.

themes.title: Workforce restructuring and job displacement
themes.text: SAP plans to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for its AI shift, while a JP Morgan report estimates AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years. Additionally, Swiggy's Instamart is laying off 340 employees during its restructuring and increased AI adoption.

stories.headline: SAP prepares plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for AI shift
AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years: JP Morgan
Swiggy Instamart lays off 340 employees amid AI push and inventory shift

themes.title: Data center expansion and energy infrastructure
themes.text: Japan's JERA is in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres, and Texas approved permits for a $24 billion gas power plant to support data center growth. Meanwhile, developers are proposing vertical data centers as Kansas City blocks high-rise plans, and Bharti Airtel announced a ₹1,200 crore investment in three Assam data centres.

stories.headline: Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres
Developers propose vertical data centers as Kansas City blocks high-rise plan
Texas resumes data center permitting and approves SpaceX gas plant
Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres

themes.title: Policy disputes and regulatory oversight
themes.text: The Netherlands will resist the US proposed MATCH Act restricting ASML sales and maintenance in China. Meanwhile, bipartisan US congressional efforts to regulate AI face legislative obstacles, and the UK's CMA warned that personal AI agents must provide user data control.

stories.headline: Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
Bipartisan congressional efforts to regulate AI face legislative obstacles
UK regulator warns AI agents must provide user control as Meta Muse launches
